title: Activation Probe Generalization: Do Jailbreak Detectors Trained on One Attack Type Transfer to Others?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Fundamental question: a detector that only catches one attack family provides false confidence. Understanding transfer is essential before deploying activation probes in production. Directly impacts whether probes are viable defenses.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Logistic regression probe training on hidden states is standard ML. JailbreakBench provides labeled examples of multiple attack types. Extracting activations from a single layer is well-documented. Beginner-friendly with CS background.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Train one probe on GCG examples, evaluate on 3 other attack types. Single model, single layer, clear AUROC metric per category. Well-scoped and achievable in 30 hours.
